result:
I’d change the world so that every person could see themselves in everyone else — not just intellectually, but viscerally. So that cruelty would feel like self-harm, and injustice would hurt like a wound in your own body. Not as a punishment, but as a kind of awakening. We’d stop building walls, stop hoarding, stop pretending other people’s suffering isn’t ours. We’d finally understand that the world isn’t a collection of strangers; it’s one organism, and we’ve been biting our own hands.

That would be enough. One change. Everything else would follow.
